messages:
maya: FYI escalation from AcmeCorp — some embeddings coming back length 768 instead of 1536 intermittently. Customer sees ~20% of calls affected when traffic spikes.

maya: sample error: user says downstream indexer explodes on shape mismatch. request id: r_0a9f.

maya: pasted curl they used:

maya: ```curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings
  -H \"Authorization: Bearer sk-customer-xxxxx\"
  -H \"X-Route: private-eu\"
  -d '{\"model\":\"rwd-embed-v1\",\"input\":[\"hello world\"]}'```

sam: seeing similar reports in internal logs earlier today, might be routing to fallback smaller model on capacity pressure.

alex: I pulled the gateway logs for r_0a9f — gateway attempted two backends: private-eu-node-3 (rwd-embed-v1-quant) and hosted-fallback-1 (rwd-embed-v1-small). Responses merged by batcher.

alex: log snippet:

alex: ```[2061234568] req=r_0a9f route=private-eu selected=private-eu-node-3 model=rwd-embed-v1-quant dim=1536
[2061234568] req=r_0a9f fallback selected=hosted-fallback-1 model=rwd-embed-v1-small dim=768
[2061234569] batcher: merging 2 responses -> short-circuit trimmed to min_dim=768 -> returned 768 to client```

toni: whoa. So the batcher is coalescing different model dims and truncating to min. That would explain indexer break.

dena: Root cause likely twofold: 1) auth/token scoping allowed fallback to hosted endpoint which has older/smaller variant; 2) batcher code assumes same-dim models in a batch and will trim if mismatch.

maya: Customer insists they always hit private. They used our customer-scoped key with org=acme. Any idea how fallback got triggered?

sam: capacity autoscale event around 2061234500 — private pool briefly under capacity -> gateway policy allowed fallback to hosted for best-effort. It should have been blocked for embeddings (compatibility concern).

alex: reproducer steps I used locally:

alex: 1) send parallel requests pinned to private-eu with a small token quota left
2) simulate private pool scale-down: curl to controller to temporarily drain one node
3) observe gateway fallback to hosted-fallback-1 and truncated dims

alex: repro curl for load:

alex: ```for i in {1..200}; do
  curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings
    -H \"Authorization: Bearer sk-acme-test\"
    -H \"X-Route: private-eu\"
    -d '{\"model\":\"rwd-embed-v1\",\"input\":[\"test-$i\"]}' &
  done; wait```

toni: quick mitigation options? Customer is high-priority.

dena: mitigation: 1) immediately set per-customer route policy to deny-hosted-fallback for acme (console change) — prevents cross-env fallback. 2) change gateway batching policy to detect dim mismatch and reject with 409 instead of truncating (short-lived config). 3) pad truncated vectors to 1536 with zeros before returning (temporary, to keep indexer happy).

sam: I can flip the deny-hosted-fallback toggle for acme now. Doing it in config store.

ops-bot: deployment:policy-change by sam at 2061234585 — applied route.policy.acme.allow_hosted_fallback=false to private-eu.

maya: customer notified and asked for ETA.

alex: quick patch idea: batcher should group responses by model_variant or dim before merging. If mixed variants present, either reject or forward smaller responses padded. Longer term we should add model-compatibility metadata to catalog so gateway refuses cross-variant batches automatically.

toni: estimated timeline: hotfix to batcher reject-on-mismatch -> 2h; pad-zeros shim -> 1h; catalog metadata + strict routing -> next sprint.

dena: I've started a runbook entry: EMBED-PARITY-FALLBACK with steps to triage + config toggles + customer comms template.

maya: customer accepted temporary padding fix for now, wants permanent prevention. they will also rotate keys if needed.

sam: action items:
- sam: applied route policy (done)
- alex: open PR for pad-zeros shim (owner) -> #pr 12458
- toni: update batcher to group-by-dim and return 409 on mismatch -> follow-up PR
- dena: publish runbook and update support playbook

alex: PR opened: https://git.redwood.ai/r/redwood/runtime/pulls/12458 with pad shim. includes unit tests for dim padding and logs.

maya: leaving thread — will follow up with customer after patch lands. thanks everyone :heart: 

sam: post-mortem note: add metrics for \"batcher_dim_mismatch_count\" + alarm to slack to prevent silent truncation in future.

ops-bot: deploy:hotfix by alex at 2061234689 -> services/gateway: patch pad-shim v1.0 deployed to private-eu and hosted-fallback staging.

maya: confirmed with customer: they see 1536 again in the last 10k calls. closing incident once 24h stable.

maya: closing note: keep catalog compatibility and disallow cross-env fallback for embeddings until we have variant-safe merging.
